name: mu.noukaz/mauritius-property
title: Noukaz
description: Mauritius property listings, median asking prices by area, guides and a land-unit converter.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Searches the listings published on Noukaz.mu (Mauritius): houses, apartments, land and commercial premises, for sale, for rent or for short-term rent. Returns up to 12 listings in the site's relevance order, each with its asking price, location, areas and the link to its page, plus the link to the full search on the site.

transaction.description: Transaction type: "sale", "rent" (long-term rental) or "short_term_rent" (short-term rental, price per night).

property_types.description: Property types, one or several. "house", "villa" and "duplex" are three distinct types, as are "apartment" and "penthouse".

region.description: Part of the island: north, south, east, west, central or Rodrigues. Each one groups one or two districts.

district.description: One of the ten districts of Mauritius, Rodrigues included. Black River is "riviere_noire".

locality.description: Name of a town or village, for example "Grand Baie" or "Tamarin".

price_min.description: Minimum price, in Mauritian rupees: monthly rent for a rental, price per night for a short-term rental.

price_max.description: Maximum price, in Mauritian rupees: monthly rent for a rental, price per night for a short-term rental.

foreign_buyer.description: True to keep only properties for sale that a non-citizen buyer can acquire (PDS, IRS, RES, Smart City, IHS and G+2 schemes). No effect on rentals: every rental is open to foreigners.

pool.description: True to keep only properties with a pool.

sea_view.description: True to keep only properties with a sea view or on the seafront.

garden.description: True to keep only properties with a garden.

limit.description: Number of listings to return: 8 by default, 12 at most.

language.description: Language of the labels and links: "en" (default) or "fr".

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Returns the public details of one Noukaz.mu listing, by its numeric id: asking price, areas, location, features, whether a non-citizen buyer can acquire it, the advertiser's description and the link to its page. A listing that has been sold, rented or withdrawn is returned with its last status for as long as its page stays on the site.

id.description: Numeric id of the listing: the "id" field of a search result, or the number in the address of its page (noukaz.mu/biens/123/).

language.description: Language of the labels and links: "en" (default) or "fr".

tools.name: market_prices
tools.description: Returns the median prices Noukaz computes from its online listings, for Mauritius as a whole, a district or a locality: sale price, price per m², price per perche for land, and monthly rent. These are asking prices from listings, not recorded sale prices. A figure is returned only when it rests on enough listings from enough different advertisers.

locality.description: Name of a town or village, for example "Tamarin". With neither locality nor district, the figures cover the whole country.

district.description: One of the ten districts of Mauritius, Rodrigues included. Black River is "riviere_noire".

category.description: Property category, for figures by category: "houses" (houses, villas and duplexes), "apartments" (apartments and penthouses), "land", "commercial" (commercial units) or "offices". Without a category, an overview of the area.

language.description: Language of the labels and links: "en" (default) or "fr".

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Lists the guides published on Noukaz.mu about property in Mauritius — buying, places, renting and commercial property, prices and market, foreigners and non-citizens, professionals — with each guide's summary and link.

topic.description: Topic: "buying", "places", "renting_and_commercial" (rentals and commercial property), "prices_and_market" (prices and market), "foreign_buyers" (foreigners and non-citizens) or "professionals". Without a topic, all guides.

query.description: Words to find in the title or summary of the guides.

language.description: Language of the labels and links: "en" (default) or "fr".

tools.name: convert_area
tools.description: Converts an area between the land units used in Mauritius (perche, toise, arpent) and square metres, hectares, acres and square feet.

value.description: The area to convert: a number greater than 0.

language.description: Language of the labels and links: "en" (default) or "fr".
